title: Bulk DFT calculations
action: Perform self-consistent DFT calculations for bulk MnO, FeO, CoO, and NiO in the rocksalt structure. Use LDA+U (Dudarev scheme) with U=4 eV, include spin-orbit coupling and noncollinear spins. For each material, relax the cubic lattice constant until total energy is minimized; compute total magnetic moments from spin-magnetization density integrated inside PAW spheres; determine the easy axis/plane by energy comparisons of different spin orientations; and extract the Kohn-Sham band structure to obtain the indirect and direct fundamental gaps.
description: Required DFT calculations that produce the converged charge density, wavefunctions, and band energies for each material. The agent must re-run these calculations; the output serves as input for the compilation step.

title: Compile bulk properties table
action: From the completed DFT calculations, extract for each material the cubic lattice constant a0 (in Å), total magnetic moment μ (in μB), easy spin axis/plane (as a string), indirect Kohn-Sham gap E_g_ind (in eV), and direct gap E_g_dir (in eV). Assemble these into a CSV file with one row per material.
description: CSV file containing the computed bulk properties for MnO, FeO, CoO, and NiO. Each row corresponds to one material.
output_schema: material: string; a0_angstrom: float; mu_muB: float; easy_axis: string; E_g_ind_eV: float; E_g_dir_eV: float
